mcq.stem: A 60-year-old collapses. The monitor shows asystole. CPR is started. Which drug should be given next?
A 60-year-old collapses. The monitor shows asystole. CPR is started. Which drug should be given next?
mcq.explanation: Adrenaline every 3-5 minutes; atropine is no longer used in asystole.
